name: Cloudflare MCP Lab
description: A remote MCP server deployed on Cloudflare Workers with Google OAuth authentication that enables users to interact with a SQL database containing employee data. Demonstrates how to build authenticated MCP servers with OAuth integration on Cloudflare infrastructure.
